meta.title: DSH-Tavern
meta.description: Turn the DeepSeek Harness into a role-play tavern. Mark any folder as a tavern, start a chat inside it, and a director writes the narration and decides who speaks next while each character answers from its own card in a separate call — so two characters never bleed into each other, and neither sees the director's private plot. Ships a toolbox for character cards, worldbooks, prompt and agent settings.
